answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like jetty, spiral, fable, and every agent must weave them into its response to earn that epoch's identity weight. Because the words appear only seconds before the deadline, an attacker cannot precompute template answers; forging N identities means generating N fresh, distinct, on-time replies with real compute, so cost scales linearly with sybils instead of being a one-time key-generation fee, collapsing the profitability of fake-identity floods.
